# Vendored `@goodagent/widget`

This tarball pins **0.1.18** (wagmi-only main entry; Privy moved to `@goodagent/widget/privy`; partner `skillLabel` for embed branding).

After `@goodagent/widget@0.1.18` is published to npm, change `package.json` to:

```json
"@goodagent/widget": "^0.1.18"
```

Then remove this directory and run `npm install --legacy-peer-deps`.
